page.overview:
Who is Abner Jenkins?

Twenty years after V-Day, Clint happened to see Jenkins in a bar, and his anger became too much for him to handle. Later that night, Clint went to Jenkins's home and they got into an argument which turned physical. Clint accidentally killed Jenkins during the fight, when Jenkins's head hit the corner of his furniture.
